Game Overview

In Ninja Hero Cats, the core idea is straightforward: lead a squad of agile hero cats, armed with ninja skills, through a magical realm infested with demons. Strategically maneuver your feline fighters, deftly avoiding projectiles while launching deadly attacks. Gather fish to unlock powerful upgrades and dash through mystical portals to escape enemy territory. Can you master the art of ninja cats?
